rows.note: Use this when the focus is carrying or transporting a load, rather than putting it into something.

example.english: Our car can't load that many boxes.
example.traditional: 我哋架車載唔到咁多箱。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gaa3 ce1 zoi2 m4 dou2 gam3 do1 soeng1

rows.note: Use this for a large amount or number, especially in phrases such as 一大堆禮物.

example.english: There’s a load of documents on the desk waiting for me to read.
example.traditional: 枱面有一大堆文件，等住我睇。
example.jyutping: toi2 min6 jau5 jat1 daai6 deoi1 man4 gin6 dang2 zyu6 ngo5 tai2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when the load is a burden on someone, whether physical or a worry.

example.english: Taking care of two kids is a heavy load for me.
example.traditional: 照顧兩個細路對我嚟講係好大負擔。
example.jyutping: ziu3 gu3 loeng5 go3 sai3 lou6 deoi3 ngo5 lai4 gong2 hai6 hou2 daai6 fu6 daam1

rows.note: Use this for putting ammunition, film, paper, or another item into equipment so it is ready to use.

example.english: We need to load paper into the printer before we can use it.
example.traditional: 部打印機要裝紙先用得。
example.jyutping: bou6 daa2 jan3 gei1 jiu3 zong1 zi2 sin1 jung6 dak1

rows.note: Use this for one batch or shipment of goods or material transported or processed at once.

example.english: A load of goods will arrive today, so remember to sign for it.
example.traditional: 今日會到一批貨，記住簽收。
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 wui5 dou3 jat1 pai1 fo3 gei3 zyu6 cim1 sau1

rows.note: Use this specifically for loading data or a program into a computer or other digital system.

example.english: The system will load the update program shortly.
example.traditional: 系統即將載入更新程式。
example.jyutping: hai6 tung2 zik1 zoeng1 zoi3 jap6 gang1 san1 cing4 sik1

rows.note: Use this specifically for one washing-machine load of clothes.

example.english: I still have one load of laundry to wash.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung6 jau5 jat1 gei1 saam1 mei6 sai2

rows.note: Use this when someone tampers with something to rig the result in their favour.

example.english: They tampered with the figures to load the dice in their favour.
example.traditional: 佢哋改咗啲數字，仲做手腳想偏幫自己。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 goi2 zo2 di1 sou3 zi6 zung6 zou6 sau2 goek3 soeng2 pin1 bong1 zi6 gei2
